Sandbox_HMR_RandomizeInitialCondition_To: If enabled, HMR will randomize the initial condition of Blade/Handle when the weapon is first seen. If disabled, parts start matching the vanilla weapon condition.
Sandbox_HMR_PartDegradeMult_Tooltip: Multiplies how fast Blade/Handle degrade while using the weapon. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_HMR_DegradeEveryNHits_Tooltip: Parts degrade once every N successful hits. 1 = every hit.
Sandbox_HMR_TimeMult_Replace_Tooltip: Multiplies the duration of the Replace part timed action.
Sandbox_HMR_TimeMult_Repair_Tooltip: Multiplies the duration of the Repair part timed action.
Sandbox_HMR_TimeMult_Clean_Tooltip: Multiplies the duration of the Clean part timed action.
Sandbox_HMR_TimeMult_Dismantle_Tooltip: Multiplies the duration of the Dismantle weapon timed action.
